name: Release v2026.10.1
body:
## 🤖 AI-Generated Changelog

## Fixed

- Skip `*` (wildcard) versions when pinning resolved default dependencies as constraints, preventing invalid constraint generation
- Write a single `pylock.toml` entry for packages that are locked in both default and develop groups, avoiding duplicate entries
- Brace bare `$VAR` references in source URLs when generating requirements with `--no-lock`, ensuring proper shell variable expansion
- Preserve non-group conditions in `pylock.toml` markers for dependencies that reference a dependency group
- Correct artifact metadata (hashes) in `pylock.toml` output from locked package data

## Changed

- Prefetch pure-Python index manifests in parallel to speed up cold resolver performance
- Reuse resolver manifests when prefetching installable wheels, reducing redundant network requests
- Avoid redundant cold index refetches during wheel prefetch operations

---

🔗 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pypa/pipenv/compare/v2026.10.0...v2026.10.1
